name: Bubble Shooter
summary:
Bubble Shooter is a classic bubble pop shooter game, play this colorful bubble pop shooter at your leisure. Blast and pop all the bubbles, solve fun bubble pop puzzles, and pass challenges to reach level goals and win bubble pop shooter coins!

Bubble shooter is a highly addictive bubble pop shooter game loved by many! This bubble pop shooter game will kill your boredom! Swipe to pop colorful bubbles in bubble pop shooter, make sure to aim correctly and let the bubbles land exactly where you want. See which bubble color you get next so you can strategize to win and clear all the bubbles on the screen. Match 3 colors to crash the bubbles, hit the target and win the bubble pop shooter level!
